run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset point using a Phonopy object and ASE calculator
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE atoms or pymatgen Structure with displacement and supercell settings
produce_force_constants: compute force constants from displaced supercells using an ASE calculator and optional symmetrization
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies at supercell commensurate qpoints or a custom set of qpoints
calculate_thermal_properties: compute vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity on a temperature grid with Fourier interpolation
